description: This is a Java test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing shift state behavior during text input, including sentence capitalization, word capitalization, and character caps modes.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardShiftStateFromInputTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing shift state behavior in the AnySoftKeyboard input method.

methods.name: setUpForAnySoftKeyboardBase
methods.description: Overrides setup to initialize dictionary overrides for testing.

methods.name: setupForShiftTests
methods.description: Prepares the test environment for shift mode testing.

methods.name: testShiftSentences
methods.description: Tests automatic capitalization at sentence boundaries.

methods.name: testShiftNever
methods.description: Tests that no automatic shift occurs when caps mode is off.

methods.name: testShiftWords
methods.description: Tests automatic capitalization at word boundaries.

methods.name: createEditorInfoWithCaps
methods.description: Creates an EditorInfo object with specified caps mode flags.
